headline: Utility pole and underground line petitions on Washington Street, Blackburn Drive, Adams Hill Road, Highland Street, and Madison Avenue.
summary: The meeting will take up six petitions from National Grid and CommLink Integration Corp. for poles and underground lines. Two items are continued to later dates.
items: PP#2026-006: National Grid petition to install 1 JO pole on Washington Street, about 160 feet Southwest of the centerline of the Washington Street and Woodbury Street intersection. New stub pole P342-84, 40' South-East of P342.

PP#2026-007: National Grid petition to install 1 JO pole on Washington Street, about 687 feet Southwest of the centerline of the Washington Street and Woodbury Hill intersection. New stub pole P353-84, 46' East of P353.

PP#2026-008: National Grid petition to install 1 JO pole on Washington Street, about 596 feet Southwest of the centerline of the Washington Street and Woodbury Hill intersection. New stub pole P354-84, 47' East of P354.

PP#2026-009: CommLink Integration Corp. petition to install underground facilities on Blackburn Drive, about 500 feet south of the Blackburn Drive and Dory Road intersection, continuing about 670 feet west on Dory Road and then south into the 11 Dory property.

PP#2026-010: National Grid petition to install underground facilities on Adams Hill Road, starting about 800 feet Northwest of the Adams Hill Road and Walnut Street intersection. Includes about 95 feet of 2-3 inch concrete encased schedule 40 PVC and underground electric cables from HH 429 to the property line of 43 Adams Hill Road.

PP#2026-011: National Grid petition to install underground facilities on Highland Street, starting about 27 feet Northwest of the Highland Street and Highland Court intersection. Includes about 30 feet of 2-3 inch underground PVC conduits from pole #5331 to the property line of 27 Highland Street.
Matters to be continued: Amendment to Section 3.2.2 Dimensional Requirements for Multi-family Dwellings and Their Accessory Uses (other than signs), continued to December 2, 2026.

Matters to be continued: PP2026-012, National Grid petition to install 1 JO pole on Madison Avenue, about 120 feet West of the Madison Avenue and Acacia Street intersection, with related pole and conductor work, continued to November 18, 2026.

# GLOUCESTER CITY COUNCIL

## Planning & Development Committee Meeting

Wednesday, November 4, 2026 – 6:00 PM

City Hall – 1st Floor Conference Room

9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester MA 01930

## AGENDA

*(Items may be taken out of order at the discretion of the Committee)*

The public is welcome to attend in person. Zoom link to access the meeting remotely is also available:

Join from Computer, Smart Device: https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/82611401122

Join via Phone: 1 309 205 3325 or 1 312 626 6799

Meeting ID: 826 1140 1122

*Please note that the in-person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if technological problems interrupt the remote connection.*

1. PP#2026-006: Petition by National Grid to install 1 JO pole on Washington Street beginning at a point approximately 160 feet Southwest of the centerline of the intersection of Washington Street and Woodbury Street. Installing a new stube pole P342-84 40' South-East of P342. Gloucester, MA.

2. PP#2026-007: Petition by National Grid to install 1 JO pole on Washington Street beginning at a point approximately 687 feet Southwest of the centerline of the intersection of Washington Street and Woodbury Hill. Installing a new stube pole P353-84 46' East of P353. Gloucester, MA.

3. PP#2026-008: Petition by National Grid to install 1 JO pole on Washington Street beginning at a point approximately 596 feet Southwest of the centerline of the intersection of Washington Street and Woodbury Hill. Installing a new stube pole P354-84 47' East of P354. Gloucester, MA.

4. PP#2026-009: Petition by CommLink Integration Corp. to install underground facilities on Blackburn Drive approximately 500 feet south of the intersection of Blackburn Drive and Dory Road, to continue approximately 670 feet west on Dory Road and then south into the 11 Dory property.

5. PP#2026-010: Petition by National Grid to install underground facilities on Adams Hill Road. Beginning at a point approximately 800 feet Northwest of the centerline of the intersection of Adams Hill Road and Walnut Street and continuing approximately 95 feet in a Southeastern direction. The proposed installation of +/- 95' of 2-3" concrete encased schedule 40 PVC and underground electric distribution cables from HH 429 to the property line of 43 Adams Hill Road. Gloucester, MA.

6. PP#2026-011: Petition by National Grid to install underground facilities on Highland Street. Beginning at a point approximately 27 feet Northwest of the centerline of the intersection of Highland Street and Highland Court and continuing approximately 20 feet in a Northwest direction. National Grid is petitioning to install +/- 30' of 2-3" underground PVC conduits from pole #5331 to the property line of 27 Highland Street. Gloucester, MA.

## MATTERS TO BE CONTINUED

1. Amendment to the Section 3.2.2 Dimensional Requirements for Multi-family Dwellings and Their Accessory Uses (other than signs) (cont. to December 2, 2026)

2. PP2026-012: Petition by National Grid to install 1 JO Pole on Madison Avenue beginning at a point approximately 120 feet West of the centerline of the intersection of Madison Avenue and Acacia Street and continuing approximately 19 feet in a Northern direction. Proposed installation of pole #4590-50 with a sidewalk fixtured anchor and guy wire. Removal of secondary conductor from pole #5490 to pole #5485 and installation of secondary conductor from new pole #5490-50 to pole #5485. Gloucester, MA. (cont. to November 18, 2026)
